originalText: Crawl a brand's site, check what AI engines can read and lift · polite, incremental, JS only when needed

text:
Key decisions
- One queue per domain = politeness
- Bloom filter for 'seen URL?'
  (tiny memory, no false misses)
- Render JS only when the raw HTML
  is empty (10x cheaper)
- Re-crawl changed pages first
  (ETag / Last-Modified)
- Check GPTBot/ClaudeBot not blocked
